740010101.text: Ah! You there! You look most reliable, good knight. Please, help us!

740010104.text: The evil minions of the fell dragon Narcissus have surrounded Petit Chou! We must help her!

740010201.text: Well, guess we won't be worrying about this mysterious bubble cannon anymore.

740010203.text: Huh, where's that voice coming from? Does "soldiers" refer to us?

740010204.text: Wonderful! It seems that Colonel Kate is still here. Let's go meet up with him.

740013302.text: Is that... the "Petit Chou" you were referring to, Ann?

740010301.text: Where's the rest of your team?

740010401.text: Aren't you the same as the Orchestre Jak?

740010402.text: What? We're as different as night and day! Why, that Jak... One day, people like him will warp the very essence of our resistance movement!

740010403.text: Hmm. Isn't the Orchestre Jak's goal to defeat Narcissus and save Princess Lyris— sorry, Ms. Lyris? Aren't your goals the same?

740010404.text: Aye, and there's the rub! He does not recognize her as our rightful Princess! He is, simply put, a problem waiting to happen!

740010405.text: Today, he refuses to recognize her! What will he do tomorrow? Lead his Orchestre to overturn the kingdom!?

740010406.text: #(Uh, {NICKNAME}, what do we do? Jak does seem like the sorta guy who might do that!)

740010409.text: Alright, alright. Our goals are aligned! We're all doing this for Princess Lyris and the Reconquista, right?

740010410.text: Hmm. It seems like the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom's situation is kinda complicated... Wait. What about your team?

740014102.text: #It is our great fortune to have met you, good knight {NICKNAME}. It seems that the time has come at last for the Reconquista! The Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team shall reclaim the realm and rescue Princess Lyris.

740014103.text: Come, Petit Chou, let us do as we planned. First, let's get rid of all this foul water!

740014501.text: Ugh! Paimon's starting to get confused about what counts as a dragon...

740014507.text: Our purpose defines our essence. At this time, we are the heroes challenging the wicked dragon, and he is the wicked dragon. This is sufficient.

740014508.text: Huh, this must be what Al means when he says "A rose by any other name would smell just as sweet!"

740014509.text: That is precisely the case, dear Petit Chou. Were you not called "Petit Chou," you would still be my dearest younger sister.

740014510.text: ...So, so long as that's the tower your Princess sleeps in, the one lurking atop the tower is the fell dragon Narcissus. Is that right?

740014511.text: No, I fear. As we stated previously, he is "not here now," which is why we were able to win our way here so easily. That up there is the dragon's hatred made manifest.

740014512.text: That's so complicated... Can't it just be an ordinary statue?

740014513.text: Like, you know, Narcissus commanding his underlings to make an image of him on the highest tower, so as to show off his greatness, and force all the people of the land to look upon him... or something?

740014514.text: Well... You actually make a reasonable point, Paimon. But if that was the case, then we should still have been able to see it even before Petit Chou made the foul water disappear, right?

740014515.text: But instead, Narcissus's evil has melded with the waters, which is why his wicked intent crystallized into that image once the waters were drained.

740014516.text: Is that seriously how it happened...?

740014517.text: The fell dragon is truly terrifying. My talons hurt just looking at him...

740014518.text: #Well, we have our knight, {NICKNAME}, so we should be fine even if he is present, yes?

740014505.text: ...Come on, that can't be right! How would we be able to communicate and understand this world otherwise?

740014506.text: I agree with the knight here. Our categories should not define our essence.

740010801.text: Ugh, all this water... Is this some kind of Oceanid magic?

740010802.text: Phew. The defensive power has weakened. There will also be less obstacles for us to fight from here on out.

740010804.text: #Ann, {NICKNAME}, let's go help my brother Al!

740010805.text: Your brother? Is he another character?

740010806.text: Well, Petit Chou and I can't be the only members of the team. We don't quite think *that* highly of ourselves.

740010807.text: We certainly aren't as strong as you or Paimon...

740010808.text: Al covered our escape when we retreated. Now that Narcissus's power is waning, let's go help him.

740010901.text: We charged bravely into the Bubble Formation!

740010902.text: Yes, yes, and where's your team?

740010904.text: We charged bravely into the Bubble Formation! And as for the rest... please, don't ask...

740010905.text: Looks like Colonel Kate's got problems, too...

740010906.text: Well, he is up against immense firepower... or should I say, waterpower.

740010908.text: I plan on going behind enemy lines to see what can be done there. After all, it should be quite easy to go up there now that the Bubble Formation has been broken. I mean, I can't lose to some new recruit, can I?

740010911.text: Hmph! Regardless, I shall return when the sun sinks into the sea, victory in hand! Let us meet again before the high tower.

740010913.text: Wait. There's neither sun nor sea here!

740011102.text: What? Dvalin's a whole different story from Oceanids. Dvalin's super blue, his wings are huge, and he can fly...

740011103.text: What!? That's... exactly like the fell dragon!

740011302.text: Who... became the embodiment of primal energies and Liyue's enemy?

740011303.text: I see. So it was a being as evil as Narcissus, then?

740011305.text: And how are they different? Narcissus represents primordial regression and aggregation, and is our foe.

740011306.text: Well... Uh... But Azhdaha's from Liyue! That's a huge difference... right?

740011402.text: A being whose true form cannot be grasped by humanity, and who can summon all manner of servants...

740011403.text: That does sound quite like Narcissus. Inscrutable and a master of many servants. That must've been a grueling battle. Very impressive!

740011501.text: No, no, we've definitely met other dragons before...

740016301.text: The name is merely an analogy, for we weave resistance like an orchestra in our struggle against Narcissus as we seek to rescue Ms. Lyris.

740016304.text: That's right. Isn't Lyris a Princess?

740016305.text: Well, both terms refer to the same person. But leaving that aside, we should...

740016306.text: Listen well. The title "Princess" is a rigid, hierarchical term of address, a product of an oppressive system. It was a title whose merit is birth, not labor or wisdom.

740016308.text: If the universe was a more rational one, there would be no gods, no kings, and certainly no princes or princesses. Nor would there be mystical powers that only a few may wield.

740016309.text: Do you follow me thus far?

740012601.text: We must destroy the three <color=#00E1FFFF>Bubble Formations</color> set up by Narcissus before we head up.

740012603.text: They are underhanded contraptions powered by <color=#00E1FFFF>Hydrograna</color> that can bombard intruders from a great distance... Perhaps you might have already seen one on the way here.

740012604.text: Ann speaks true. The road ahead will be vastly more perilous if we do not first destroy those Formations.

740012605.text: Hmph. Kate should have been in charge of eliminating them before we attacked. But it seems that he might have been smashed into seafoam already.

740012606.text: Don't say that! We should be hoping that he made it — he is our comrade in the end, isn't he?

740012607.text: In that case, our next task is the destruction of the Bubble Formations! After that, let's go to the small fountain and see what we find there!

740012608.text: #In that case, leave it to {NICKNAME}. From what Petit Chou and Al have said, it seems like only {M#his}{F#her} attacks will work...

740012610.text: #Paimon didn't mean to put you down! You guys have been fighting Narcissus and trying to save Princess Lyris for so long... But just leave this bit to {NICKNAME}, alright?

740012615.text: Alright! In that case, let me lead the way!

740012002.text: Is that some kind of musical troupe?

740012101.text: That sounds oddly similar to Kate's Resistance Front.

740012102.text: That's what Paimon wanted to say too!

740012103.text: Kate's Resistance Front? Bah! That disorganized, untrained militia are but rabble!

740012104.text: We here at Orchestre Jak are a collective of people from all walks of life who carry out operations based on our personal abilities.

740012105.text: Ooh, Paimon knows! The Orchestre's in charge of music and the Resistance Front resists, so they're not the same at heart, like bards and knights!

740012203.text: He wasn't always like this. He once had a really good heart, and loved to cry. He would take care of the younger children...

740012204.text: But one day, he said that he would never cry again, and later still, he changed. This might be due to Rene, I fear... and Rene changed too...

740012210.text: You should ask Jak and the others about our course of action. He and Al might argue a lot, but they're actually good friends.

740012406.text: *cough* Ann told us that you could explain the situation...

740012408.text: Allow me to speak first then, honored Knight and Paimon. Concerning the tower before us, Narcissus has been unable to overcome it. As such, the Princess is still safe.

740012409.text: At that time, when all seemed lost, the Princess gave her greatest treasure to us, and that was the "time" that belonged to her.

subQuests.subQuestName: Use force to clear up any misunderstandings!

740012701.text: We must destroy the three <color=#00E1FFFF>Bubble Formations</color> set up by Narcissus before we head up.

740012703.text: They are underhanded contraptions powered by Hydrograna that can bombard intruders from a great distance... Perhaps you might have already seen one on the way here.

740012704.text: Oh, so that's what you call those annoying bubble cannons!

740012705.text: That's right. We already solved one part of the problem on the way here, but we'll need to finish the job if our road up is to be made safe.

740012706.text: Hmph. Kate should have been in charge of eliminating them before we attacked. But it seems that he might have been smashed into seafoam already.

740012707.text: Don't say that! We should be hoping that he made it — he is our comrade in the end, isn't he?

740012708.text: Whatever the case, our next task is the destruction of the remaining Bubble Formations! After that, let's go to the small fountain and see what we find there!

740012709.text: #In that case, leave it to {NICKNAME}. From what Petit Chou and Al have said, it seems like only {M#his}{F#her} attacks will work...

740012711.text: #Paimon didn't mean to put you down! You guys have been fighting Narcissus and trying to save Princess Lyris for so long... But just leave this bit to {NICKNAME}, alright?

740012716.text: Alright! In that case, let me lead the way!

740012801.text: Silly dog, Mori! Bad! They're good people!

740012803.text: Huh. You really are a dog...

740012804.text: You and Paimon shake hands with Mori.\nIt's a slippery experience, as one might expect of a "dog" made of water.

740012805.text: Great, now we're all introduced. Don't attack them, okay, Mori?

740012806.text: Ah, so you're a dog. This makes much more sense.

740012807.text: Does it? Does it really? How does Mori resemble a dog at all?

740012809.text: What? Don't you go believing that "purpose defines essence" nonsense... and even if you do, Paimon won't!

740012810.text: But that's what Mori is, though. A silly dog.

740012812.text: Ugh, whatever! If an Oceanid can be an evil dragon, then a Forest Boar can be a dog! Alright? Alright!

740012813.text: I am a silly dog, yes. Woof.

740012814.text: And you've been a good boy, haven't you, guarding this place?

740012815.text: So, is Mori a member of your team?

740012816.text: No... I mean, Mori is a dog.

740012817.text: But a duck, a frog, a finch, and a squirrel can join... So why can't a dog?

740012818.text: Mori is Mori. Must protect the princess.

740012819.text: A long, long time ago, Mori played here. With the Princess, Al, Petit Chou, Ney, and Jak.

740012820.text: But the air and water were later filled with the scent of evil, and everyone left.

740012821.text: Only the Princess remains. So I protect her.

740012823.text: Right! It was mentioned earlier that the Princess lost her treasure, which is why everything stagnated. So this is where it was!

740012825.text: This is just a statue of the Princess. She's still in the tower.

740012828.text: Seriously? Another "looks like it, but not really"?

740012830.text: Nope. Princess Lyris is in her tower.

740012832.text: No, silly. This one's not real.

740012834.text: Well, try giving it a sniff.

740012838.text: Well, it's an understandable mistake. In this Annapausis, a boar is a dog, an Oceanid is an evil dragon, and the evil dragon turned out to be a statue...

740012827.text: That's right. This is only a statue of her.

740013001.text: But before we ascend, we need to deal with the various Bubble Formations to make safe our path.

740013002.text: Bubble Formations... There's three of them, right? If that's the case, we've already taken them all out!

740013003.text: My, that's our mighty knight and Paimon for you! Ah, it's just a shame that I was unable to watch the battle between you and the Three Royal Blades of Narcissus in person!

740013008.text: Ah, what reliable allies you are. When you've the time, please do tell Petit Chou and I of that valorous deed!

740013010.text: In that case, to the fountain! We'll find a way to access the waters above and retrieve Princess Lyris's treasure!

740013011.text: Al, Petit Chou, Jak, this place is yours to guard!

740013007.text: #The three leaders who were defending the three Bubble Formations. They were quickly dispatched by {NICKNAME}, though, as if they were mere chaff.

740010602.text: Wait. So Petit Chou is a Finch...?

740010604.text: Regardless, it's good that you're well, Petit Chou! Now let me introduce these two...

740010605.text: Um, actually, I haven't yet asked you two your names...

740010607.text: #Are you seriously still hung up about that? {M#He}{F#She}'s {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon!

740011601.text: Al! You're safe! I was so worried...

740011602.text: Ah, my dear Petit Chou — and you too, Ann! We meet again at last. In those darkest of days, I thought of you, and drew strength to fight on from those thoughts.

740011603.text: Thank you, noble warriors, you who have come forth to uphold the cause of justice. Why, had I arms as slender as yours, I would tip my hat to honor you.

740011604.text: There's no need to be so prim and proper...

740011605.text: Ann introduces you and Paimon to Al and explains what happened previously.

740011606.text: Uh, but why's a finch's older brother a duck?

740011607.text: Why a "duck," you ask? Are such definitions important? I have a supple body, an iron will, and webbed feet with which to tread water. Of these I am proud, and that is enough.

740011608.text: And Petit Chou is Petit Chou. The sphere is the shape closest to perfection, and the most complicated of all shapes. I am most proud of my sister.

740011609.text: S—Seriously, brother, what are you talking about...

740011613.text: We members of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team are disparate indeed, but we have one goal. We shall save Princess Lyris, and we shall defeat the fell dragon Narcissus!

740011614.text: Well said. The person I am now knows only that the one who stands before me is a noble and valiant knight who possesses the iron will needed to defeat Narcissus. That is enough for me.

740011615.text: Usually, the mightier the will, the larger the form needed to be its vessel, as it is in the case of Narcissus. This knight's stature is much like mine, and yet...

740011616.text: Ugh... Seriously, the first and last thing Paimon understood here was "Narcissus." You're always going on about Narcissus this and Narcissus that... But what is it, really?

740011617.text: Look up, above Princess Lyris's tower — that is Narcissus.

740011618.text: Huh? That wasn't there before the water rose...

740011803.text: Hmm. As I thought, you were the ones who emptied the water out. Excellent, excellent! If I had hands like yours, yellow and white ones, I would be applauding already.

740011804.text: Dear friend, please show some respect. Petit Chou is doing her best...

740011805.text: Hmph. You are right, I suppose. She has done nothing wrong. Ultimately...

740011807.text: Forget it. The yellow and white ones here... Who are they?

740011808.text: Yellow and white... You mean us?

740011809.text: And who else would I mean? Does Petit Chou look yellower to you? Or does Ann?

740011811.text: #Alright, alright, Paimon, please don't be angry. Jak, this is knight {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

740011812.text: Hmph. A knight, you say... Then I suppose this Paimon is the squire?

740011813.text: No, no! Come on, why does everyone call Paimon that!?

740011816.text: Is that how it is? No wonder Paimon's such a good talker!

740011817.text: #Hey! You stop that, {NICKNAME}, or Paimon's gonna come up with a... lively limerick to give you a licking the likes of which you've never seen!

740011820.text: I see. Then you are not some minor feudal warrior. Not in the usual sense, anyway. Are you, then, some "honorary knight," one with a title that comes with little benefit?

740011821.text: #Well, {NICKNAME} is an Honorary Knight, but {M#he}{F#she} got it in Mondstadt for heroically doing battle with Stormterror!

740011822.text: Ah, then you are a dutiful, capable warrior. Very good! In that case, welcome to Orchestre Jak.

740012301.text: Ann! You look well. That is good. These two are reinforcements, then?

740012303.text: Halt. I do not wish to know soldiers' names.

740012304.text: Amidst cruel battle, anyone can be turned into ruptured bubbles and scattered foam at any time. Knowing the names of the troops will only cast a shadow upon our final victory.

740012306.text: I just need to know one thing. Are they the reinforcements you sought?

740012308.text: Very good. Fresh hands will help us continue our suppression of the two remaining Bubble Formations.

740012310.text: Next time, soldier, you will give your report first before asking questions. Yes, the Formations are places of unparalleled peril — not to mention the three mighty subordinates that Narcissus has placed within them.

740012311.text: Well, about that... We've actually cleared all the Formations...

740012312.text: What!? Why didn't you say so earlier?

740012313.text: We've been trying to tell you, but you haven't been listening!

740012315.text: Um... Ha. Hahaha. Well then, it's good to see that everyone is well! So, Ann, who are these people again?

740012317.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, hmm? Pleased to make your acquaintance.

740012321.text: It's a pleasure to have new blood like you in Kate's Resistance Front. Let us fight for Princess Lyris and the Reconquista!

740012322.text: Kate's Resistance Front, huh. Are you guys the same thing as the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team?

740012323.text: Let me think... "We are now the same thing," is how I would put it.

740012324.text: Indeed. We have the same objective and plan of action. It is only because I have more combat experience that I am a colonel with my own force.

740013401.text: Since the Bubble Formations are gone, let's head to the little fountain. It's just over there!

740016101.text: I don't know much about music.

740016601.text: We charged bravely into the Bubble Formation!

740016602.text: Yes, yes, and where's your team?

740016604.text: We charged bravely into the Bubble Formation! And as for the rest... please, don't ask...

740016605.text: Looks like Colonel Kate's got problems, too...

740016606.text: Well, he is up against immense firepower... or should I say, waterpower.

740016608.text: I plan on going behind enemy lines to see what can be done there. After all, it should be quite easy to go up there now that the Bubble Formation has been broken. I mean, I can't lose to some new recruit, can I?

740016611.text: Hmph! Regardless, I shall return when the sun sinks into the sea, victory in hand! Let us meet again before the high tower.

740016613.text: Wait. There's neither sun nor sea here!

740016614.text: Since the Bubble Formations are gone, let's head to the little fountain. It's just over there!

740019901.text: What is the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team anyway?

740019902.text: Hmm? Well, after the Narzissenkreuz Kingdom was conquered by Narcissus the fell dragon...

740019903.text: We banded together to rescue Princess Lyris and reclaim the realm. That's the basic answer, anyway.

740019904.text: That doesn't sound basic at all, but we'll talk about that later. We've got people to save first!

740019905.text: That's right. Come with me, this way!

740019906.text: Mwa—hahahah! I have you now, Petit Chou of the Narzissenkreuz Adventure Team!

740019907.text: I—If you don't leave, I'm gonna get serious! Grrr!

740019908.text: #This reminds Paimon of the time you became a knight, {NICKNAME}. After fighting the dragon, we were sent off to the temples of the Four Winds...

740019910.text: Hmm... Why was that, again? Paimon recalls that we destroyed something inside the temples to decrease the dragon's power...

740019911.text: I see, so they were temples in name, but dens of evil in truth!

740019912.text: Um, were there four temples of the Four Winds, or just one?

740019913.text: There were three, actually... Huh, why *were* there only three?

740019915.text: It's been quite a while... There must've been a reason. Paimon just doesn't remember it...

740019916.text: Hmm. That does make sense. The trivial details of a brilliant knight's deeds wouldn't matter much, would they?
